description: Lossless editing JSON contract for kces.preset.

containerDirectories.description: The actual child-directory version map in the VirtualDirectory container.
containerDirectories.title: Preset directories
containerDirectories.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep directory names and declared versions coherent with the preset file paths.
containerDirectories.x-meido-game-usage: VirtualDirectory recreates named directories before writing the preset's known and extra files.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: MaidPreset stores thumbnail, maiddata, and optional meta files in a VirtualDirectory; maiddata contains compressed MaidPresetCore property, color, and body byte blocks.
VirtualDirectory writes a fixed signature, a serialize-type byte, raw virtual-file data, compressed indexed metadata, and a trailing metadata length using its declared current layout.

containerVersion.title: Preset container version
containerVersion.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve the source value; use 1000 for a new current KCES preset.
containerVersion.x-meido-game-usage: VirtualDirectory serializes the preset using this version and its corresponding indexed metadata layout.

x-meido-source-evidence.observation: MaidPreset stores thumbnail, maiddata, and optional meta files in a VirtualDirectory; maiddata contains compressed MaidPresetCore property, color, and body byte blocks.
VirtualDirectory writes a fixed signature, a serialize-type byte, raw virtual-file data, compressed indexed metadata, and a trailing metadata length using its declared current layout.

extraFiles.description: Independent virtual files whose names are outside thumbnail, maiddata, and meta.
extraFiles.title: Additional preset files
extraFiles.x-meido-edit-guidance: Retain names and bytes only for files outside all three known names; known preset files must use typed fields and may never fall back here.
extraFiles.x-meido-game-usage: MaidPreset ignores these independently named files while VirtualDirectory stores their real byte-array payloads.

format.description: The marker for the KCES VirtualDirectory preset envelope.
format.title: Editing format marker
format.x-meido-game-usage: It identifies the current KCES preset representation and distinguishes it from legacy COM3D2_PRESET.

maidData.description: The typed maiddata object containing versioned property, color, and body structures.
maidData.title: Maid preset core
maidData.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep the core version and all three typed structures from the same source preset generation.
maidData.x-meido-game-usage: MaidPreset hands the corresponding encoded blocks to Maid's property, multi-color, and body deserializers when applying a preset.

meta.description: Optional compressed MessagePack metadata, normally including the preset display name.
meta.title: Preset metadata
meta.x-meido-edit-guidance: Preserve keys understood by the target browser and retain unknown metadata entries.
meta.x-meido-game-usage: MaidPreset loads meta for preset-browser information and saves it as a separate virtual file.

thumbnail.description: PNG thumbnail bytes stored in the thumbnail virtual file.
thumbnail.title: Preset thumbnail
thumbnail.x-meido-edit-guidance: Keep valid PNG data or preserve the original thumbnail when editing character blocks.
thumbnail.x-meido-game-usage: MaidPreset decodes these bytes for the preset browser preview; they do not directly change character state.
